unavailable.physicalCorrectDigitRate: No reviewed continuous anatomical identity labels
unavailable.anatomicalIdentitySwitches: Logical ID changes are not digit-switch ground truth
unavailable.physicalRecoverySuccess: Availability returns lack continuous anatomical recovery labels
unavailable.captureToVisibleLatency: Original capture/completion clocks are reused; sensor exposure and display presentation are unobserved
unavailable.freshInferenceCostAndThroughput: No neural execution, camera pacing or display in this benchmark
unavailable.statisticalUncertainty: Single serially correlated development recording; frame-binomial confidence intervals would imply unsupported independence
unavailable.completedPhysicalCalibration: Diagnostic prompts are not a target-responsive calibration recording

limits: Every chronological packet is interpreted once per arm without resets. Original clocks are unchanged.
CPU distributions measure this Node interpretation run, including cloning and adapter/gate overhead; exclude decoding, model inference, camera and rendering.
Availability, logical identity and reference-region proximity are separate from physical correctness and acceptance.
Reference uncertainty regions remain annotation uncertainty; missing positions stay in the denominator.
Prompt names are instructions, not verified motion or gesture labels.
